faq.question: What insurance and TPAs do you accept?
faq.answer: We support cashless treatment with most major health insurance providers and third-party administrators. Bring your policy details to the billing desk and we'll verify your coverage before admission.

faq.question: Emergency room or an OPD appointment — which do I need?
faq.answer: Go straight to Emergency (or call 108) for anything severe: chest pain, difficulty breathing, heavy bleeding, or loss of consciousness. For everything else, booking an OPD appointment gets you seen by the right specialist without the wait.

faq.question: How do I get a copy of my medical records?
faq.answer: Use the confirmation token from any appointment you've booked in the My Records section above to pull up your visit details. For full medical history, request a copy at the reception desk.

faq.question: What should I bring to my first appointment?
faq.answer: A photo ID, your insurance card if you have one, a list of current medications, and any prior test results or referral letters relevant to your visit.

faq.question: Is parking available on site?
faq.answer: Yes — visitor parking is available at the main entrance, with dedicated short-stay spots near Emergency.
